purpose: on-prem application Skill sources; not personal ChatGPT skill installation
notes: temperature=0 reduces sampling variability but does not guarantee deterministic serving
topic/reference loads are explicit; arbitrary filesystem paths are prohibited
Maintenance is an offline development workflow, not an online user-triggered role
Model deployment and revision limits come from config/config.yaml plus site overlay; compile_prompt without settings is source validation only.
Role output contracts require decision/stage/search_mode, Judge coverage/return_to and Answer status. 32000 character ceiling; actual model token budgeting remains a deployment check.
ReAct rules live in core/references/react.md; Router tool parameters live in its references/tools.json. All roles and schemas resolve through this registry.
